Unofficial integration requirements document (proGres interoperability referrals via PING and OpenFn). Its appendix gives example retrieval payloads (QueryParameters as ParameterName/Value) and an ingestion payload with an Attachments array on the BAU-UAT host; used only for request-body fields.

src/Utils.js (B2C token request, APIM headers), src/http.js (post JSDoc example), test/Adaptor.test.js (ingestion and paged-retrieval paths and fixture bodies) and configuration-schema.json (hosts, scope).

notes: ping is not a connectivity probe (the repo classification says so, wrongly): it targets UNHCR's PRIMES Interoperability Gateway (PING), the APIM-fronted API partners use to exchange data with proGres/PRIMES. The adaptor (1.1.3) authenticates against Azure AD B2C (ROPC password grant, hard-coded UAT user-flow path) and sends Bearer + Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key to configuration.baseUrl via http.post/http.request; ast.json is empty because those live in the http namespace. PING's reference is shared only with partners under a Data Sharing Arrangement, so this models the three endpoints evidenced by the adaptor source and tests (token, POST /api/ingestion/v2/{partnerId}/data, POST /primes/fetch/paging/v3/retrievedatawithpaging); response bodies come from OpenFn's test fixtures, not vendor docs. Best-effort (private-api): http.request can reach any other PING route, which cannot be enumerated. The July stub's /ping, /records and /token paths were invented and are removed.
